title: Open, closed, locally closed, constructible and locally union-of-locally-closed subsets of a Jacobson space are Jacobson

standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of a Jacobson space through the property that every locally closed subset has a closed point, and the notion of a constructible set
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's sections on Jacobson spaces and on constructible sets, before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the property to be inherited and the list of subset types for which it is claimed.

core_obligations: The device of property (*): for a subset T the author introduces the property that every nonempty locally closed subset of T has a point closed in X, and shows that this property characterises the Jacobson property for T and implies the final sentence about closed points (proof lines 3659-3668).

The list handled uniformly: each of the six types of subsets is shown to satisfy (*) because a locally closed subset of such a T is itself locally closed in X or a union of such, and X is Jacobson (proof lines 3668-3674).
The closing step: given a nonempty locally closed piece, Jacobsonness of X supplies a point closed in X, which is what (*) requires (proof lines 3674-3675).
Conclusion: the six cases and the assertion that closed points of T are closed in X (proof line 3675).
proof_roadmap: 引入辅助性质 (*)：T 的每个非空局部闭子集都有在 X 中闭的点；它等价于 T 的 Jacobson 性并给出末句结论。
六类子集都满足 (*)：其局部闭子集本身是 X 的局部闭子集（或局部闭子集之并），由 X 是 Jacobson 得到闭点。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the inheritance of the Jacobson property by the six listed types of subsets of a Jacobson space (author lemma at source lines 3641-3656, label lemma-jacobson-inherited), together with the assertion that closed points of the subset are closed in the ambient space. The proof (source lines 3658-3675) is organised around the auxiliary property that every non-empty locally closed subset has a point closed in the ambient space, which the author shows characterises the Jacobson property at once for all six cases and yields the closing sentence (proof lines 3659-3668); the verification is then uniform because a locally closed piece of any of the six types is locally closed in the ambient space (proof lines 3668-3675). H2.
